body:
## What's Changed
* fix: only allow alpha channel toggle when toggle is supported by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/16
* Allow user to change recording output location by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/17
* feat(menu-bar): add open output folder button by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/18
* feat: improve notification and live preview by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/19
* fix(menu-bar): activate app before opening settings by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/20
* feat: add toggle to hide/show BetterCapture windows by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/21
* feat: add support for HDR when using proRes422/4444 by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/22
* docs: add README.md by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/23
* feat(ci): add release, prerelease, and PR workflows by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/24
* fix: fail builds on error by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/26
* fix(build): rename iconset to match project settings by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/27
* ci: use macos-26 runners by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/28
* chore: set default output to `~/Movies/BetterCapture` by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/29
* chore: improve permission handling by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/30
* fix(settings): enforce MP4 container codec compatibility by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/32
* docs: setup CONTRIBUTING.md and update README by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/34
* ci: add path filter for deploy workflow by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/35
* docs: add high-level architecture documentation by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/40
* feat: improve settings view by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/42
* feat(sparkle): add in-app updates using Sparkle framework by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/43
* chore: bump version to 2026.1.0 by @jsattler in https://github.com/jsattler/BetterCapture/pull/44

## New Contributors
